what_this_is: a RATCHET, not a target. Existing unnamed refusals are grandfathered; a NEW one fails at the commit that adds it; the number may only move DOWN.
why_per_file: a single total lets a new unnamed refusal in one file hide behind a deletion in another
how_to_lower_it: give the refusal a NAME, re-run `--write-baseline`, and commit the lower number with the change that earned it
never_raise_it: a baseline raised to accommodate new unnamed refusals is the ratchet disarmed. If a rise is deliberate it is a USER/coordinator decision and belongs in the register, not in a quiet regeneration.
DECLARED_LIMIT: TEXTUAL PREDICATE. A cell that drives a refusal WITHOUT NAMING it reads as never-exercised, so THE ERROR INFLATES RATHER THAN DEFLATES. This is a FLOOR on what has been SEEN to be driven, never an exact defect count.

WHY_THIS_NUMBER_AND_NOT_1103.asked_by: REV, 2026-09-10 -- 'a ratchet baseline is load-bearing by construction, so it should carry its own reason on the artifact'
WHY_THIS_NUMBER_AND_NOT_1103.MEASURED_NOT_INFERRED: the two rules were run side by side over the same tree and the sites were DIFFERENCED: exactly 5 sites BECAME unnamed and 0 stopped being unnamed
WHY_THIS_NUMBER_AND_NOT_1103.the_cause: DA 201's POSITIONAL discriminator. Each of the five is a bare `REFUSED: <prose>` message whose only UPPER_SNAKE constant is one of the 13 the discriminator rejected (CAUSAL_FROZEN_FROM_TRAIN, DEVELOPMENT_READ_DAYS, FULL_SUPPLIED_COMPLEMENT, INCUMBENT_REWEIGHTED_ONLY), interpolated INSIDE the message as a value rather than leading it.
WHY_THIS_NUMBER_AND_NOT_1103.THE_STATEMENT_STRONGER_THAN_A_TIGHTENING: these five refusals were ALWAYS UNNAMED. The old rule CREDITED THEM WITH A TOKEN BORROWED from a config constant that happens to appear in the same message. The +5 is a CORRECTION of a mis-credit, not a regression and not merely a consequence of a stricter rule -- the baseline is 5 higher because the previous count was 5 too low.
WHY_THIS_NUMBER_AND_NOT_1103.direction_of_the_error_it_fixed: the old rule UNDER-counted unnamed refusals, i.e. it erred toward a CLEAN surface. That is the same direction as the other four undercounts of the day and it is the dangerous one.
WHY_THIS_NUMBER_AND_NOT_1103.what_would_make_this_number_wrong_again: a NEW constant whose value is UPPER_SNAKE being interpolated at the FRONT of a bare REFUSED message would be credited as a refusal token and drop the count. The discriminator's 13 rejections are enumerated in DA 201's commit so that class stays reviewable.

A_DEFECT_IN_THIS_RECORD_ITSELF_FOUND_BY_.what_was_wrong: this block enumerated the rejected constants in VALUE space while the source carries them in NAME space, so a reader grepping for CAUSAL_FROZEN_FROM_TRAIN finds the assignment and NOT the raise site, which interpolates CAUSAL_MODE. The list was internally consistent and read as unmatched against the source.
A_DEFECT_IN_THIS_RECORD_ITSELF_FOUND_BY_.the_class: rule 16 -- name versus value is the exact defect both seats hit today, and it turned up inside the record written to document it
A_DEFECT_IN_THIS_RECORD_ITSELF_FOUND_BY_.the_fix: both spaces are carried below, DERIVED from the source rather than typed, for ALL THIRTEEN rather than the three REV read
A_DEFECT_IN_THIS_RECORD_ITSELF_FOUND_BY_.AND_THE_REASON_NEITHER_SPACE_ALONE_IS_EN: several values carry TWO DIFFERENT NAMES in different modules -- CAUSAL_FROZEN_FROM_TRAIN is CAUSAL_MODE in be_fragment_diagnostic and THRESHOLD_PRIMARY in phase2_declaration; INCUMBENT_REWEIGHTED_ONLY is BASELINE in phase2_increment_null and INCUMBENT_ARM in phase2_iter011_run. A value-space list is not greppable to the raise site and a name-space list is AMBIGUOUS ACROSS MODULES. THE IDENTITY IS THE TRIPLE (module, name, value), not any one of them.
